sentences.text: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K. SAHOO  THE HON'BLE MISS JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO  ORDER Order No. 05.02.2025 04.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking to set aside the order dated 05.08.2024 passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, Jajpur wherein the accountant was directed to make payment as mentioned in the said order in the joint account of Bhagaban Jena, Ananta Kishore Jena and Abhaya Jena.

It appears that the mother of the petitioners Arnapurna Dhal filed a civil suit before the learned Senior Civil Judge, Jajpur vide C.S. No.642 of 2022 for apportionment and the said suit was dismissed on 24.06.2024 for default and to set aside the dismissal order dated 24.06.2024, the petitioners as the legal heirs of the said Arnapurna Dhal, who died during pendency of the said civil suit, filed C.M.A. No.79 of 2024 for restoration of the suit.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has produced the order sheets of the C.M.A. No.79 of 2024 before us on 27.01.2025, which has been taken on record.

It further appears that earlier the mother of the petitioners, Arnapurna Dhal approached this Court in W.P.(C) No.14189 of 2023, which was disposed of on 11.05.2023 and direction was issued to the Land Acquisition Officer (Civil), Jajpur to refer the L.A. Case No.C4/13 of 2022 to the competent Civil Court under section 3-H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956 to resolve the dispute regarding apportionment of the compensation amount and accordingly, the matter was referred to by the Land Acquisition Officer to the Principal Civil Court or original Jurisdiction i.e. District Judge, Jajpur.
Accordingly, the C.M.A. No.3 of 2023 was registered and the mother of the petitioners, namely,
Arnapurna Dhal was the opp. party no.1.
When the matter was taken up on 27.01.2025, we asked the learned counsel for the petitioners as to whether any steps have been taken for substitution of the deceased mother of the petitioners in the aforesaid C.M.A No.3 of 2023, learned counsel took time to produce the order sheets and accordingly, today, she has produced the order sheets of C.M.A. No.3 of 2023, which reveals that steps for substitution have already been taken.
The certified copy of the order sheets are taken on record.
There is no dispute that the learned District Judge, Jajpur in C.M.A. No.3 of 2023 is competent to adjudicate the apportionment of the compensation amount.

2 Learned counsel for the NHAI placed reliance on the case of Vinod Kumar and others -Vrs.- District Magistrate Mau and others reported in AIR 2023 Supreme Court 3337, wherein it has been held as follows:
"39.

entities.text: Vinod Kumar and others -Vrs.- District Magistrate Mau and others reported in AIR 2023 Supreme Court 3337
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We are of the view that when it comes to resolving the dispute relating to apportionment of the amount determined towards compensation, it is only the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction which can do so.

Principal Civil Court means the Court of the District Judge.
40.

Our final conclusion is as under: If any dispute arises as to the apportionment of the amount or any part thereof or to any person to whom the same or any part thereof is payable, then, the competent authority shall refer the dispute to the decision of the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the land is situated.

The competent authority possesses certain powers of the Civil Court, but in the event of a dispute of the above nature, the summary power,
vesting in the competent authority of rendering an opinion in terms of subsection (3)
of Section 3H, will not serve the purpose.
The dispute being of the nature triable by the Civil Court that the law steps in to provide for that to be referred to the decision of the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction.
The dispute regarding apportionment of the amount or any part thereof or to any person to whom the same or any part thereof is payable, would then have to be decided by that Court."

In view of the principle laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court and since the learned District Judge, Jajpur in C.M.A. No.3 of 2023 is in seisin over the matter to adjudicate the apportionment of the compensation amount, we are of the view that the amount is to be finally disbursed in terms of the order to be passed by the learned District Judge, Jajpur in C.M.A. No.3 of 2023 and not in accordance with the order passed by the Land Acquisition Officer in L.A. Case No.C4/13 of 2022 under Annexure-1.
With the following observations, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Pending application (s), if any, also stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
